summary_en: Twinbird board opposes planned Japanétt tender offer for all Twinbird shares. Opposition cites material dissynergies from change in capital structure, management philosophy divergence, and ability to execute mid-term plan independently. Tender price and acceptance terms not disclosed in this statement document.
title_en: Twinbird Board Opinion on Planned Japanétt Tender Offer for Twinbird Shares (Supplementary Materials)
translation_en_brief: On 31 August 2026, Twinbird Corporation (ticker 6897) published a supplementary board opinion statement opposing a planned public tender offer by Japanétt for Twinbird shares. This document is a continuation of the board's position, detailing three grounds for opposition: (1) material dissynergies arising from the change in capital structure, including risks to business architecture from loss of capital independence and management philosophy misalignment; (2) questioning of claimed synergies advanced by Japanétt; and (3) Twinbird's ability to execute its mid-term business plan independently. The statement does not disclose the tender price, share count, or acceptance thresholds—those terms were published in a separate Japanétt tender offer announcement. This is a board recommendation document preceding the formal offer launch.
